# orchestration_question_tool

> Ask the user a clarifying question during your workflow stage.

| | |
|---|---|
| Category | `orchestration` |
| Callable | MCP clients; in-app @ai conversations; grantable to agents |
| Filter | `https://www.dsiloed.com/api/v1/mcp?tools=orchestration_question_tool` |

## Description

This is the description the server sends to the model, verbatim.

Ask the user a clarifying question during your workflow stage. Your stage
will pause until the user answers. The pipeline coordinator will present
your question and relay the answer back to you.

Use this when you encounter ambiguity in the RFP, spec, or prior artifacts
that you cannot resolve on your own. Do NOT ask unnecessary questions —
only ask when the answer materially affects your output.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `orchestration_stage_execution_id` | integer | yes | Your stage execution ID (from the orchestration prompt) |
| `question` | string | yes | The clarifying question for the user. |
| `question_context` | string | no | Optional context — why this matters, what options you see, what depends on the answer. |
